name: HOT3D (Full Tracking Sequences)
summary: 第一人称三维手部与物体跟踪序列，配套官方读取和下载工具。
summaryEn: Egocentric 3D hand/object tracking sequences with official loading and download tools.
scale: See publisher release and split documentation
scaleZh: 规模与分割以发布方文档为准
organizationsZh: HOT3D (Full Tracking Sequences) 发布团队
accessZh: 需注册领取有时效的下载链接
license: Sequences, hand annotations and object models may have different terms
licenseZh: 序列、手部标注与物体模型可能适用不同条款
wmNote: HOT3D-Clips 是完整数据的筛选子集；不另行相加，灰度与 RGB 视图依设备而异。
wmNoteEn: HOT3D-Clips is a curated subset and is not added to the full-set count; grayscale and RGB views depend on device.

evidence.sourceTitle: HOT3D (Full Tracking Sequences) official release documentation
evidence.locator: Toolkit overview; Full dataset; registration and download sections
evidence.statement: The official toolkit provides the complete VRS-based hand/object tracking sequences and distinguishes them from the curated HOT3D-Clips subset. Tracking observations and 3D states support ordered trajectory modeling.
